promotion.reason: Both images were last rebuilt in August 2020 and carry five years of unpatched base-image changes. CodiMD's own development moved to HedgeDoc, so no fix is coming from upstream either. The template is correct and its lifecycle is proven; the app is not one to hand somebody.

data_storage: Local Store managed folder / codimd, plus a Docker volume for the database
risk_notes: Creates two Docker containers, one for CodiMD and one for its MariaDB database.
Publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only; the database is not reachable from outside the app.
Generates a database password, stores it beside the app's data, and reuses it if the app is reinstalled.
Stores notes in a Docker volume that survives an uninstall unless data deletion is chosen.
CodiMD 1.6.0 is the most recent image linuxserver publishes; upstream development moved to HedgeDoc, so security fixes should not be assumed.
